title: The Branch With the Real Problem
summary: Mr. Adeyemi swears the numbers are fine — Marina and Lekki just have more defaults because they're bigger.

client.name: Mr. Kunle Adeyemi
brief: Head office is asking why defaults are climbing, and they want to know which branch to investigate. Marina and Lekki have the most defaulted loans on the books, so that's where I told them to look.
But Ikeja is a small branch — maybe it just looks fine because it's small. I need the real picture, not just the biggest numbers.
client.thanks: Ikeja. I'd never have caught that from the raw counts — thank you for not just handing me what I expected to hear.

starterSql:
-- Which branch actually has the worst default problem?
-- Careful: branches don't all have the same number of loans.

SELECT *
FROM loans
LIMIT 20;

tables.name: loans
tables.description: Every loan issued across Meridian Capital's three branches, and its current status.

hints.title: Hint 1: A count alone doesn't say much
hints.desc: A branch with 60 loans will almost always have more defaults in raw numbers than a branch with 9 — even if it's actually doing better.

hints.title: Hint 2: Default RATE is defaults out of total loans
hints.desc: For each branch, divide its defaulted loans by all of its loans.
hints.snippet: SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'defaulted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*)

hints.title: Hint 3: Sort by that rate, not the raw count
hints.desc: GROUP BY branch, order by default rate descending, and take the top one.

findings.claim: Which branch actually has the worst default problem?

options.text: Marina — it has the most defaulted loans on the books
Ikeja — a much higher share of its loans default, even though it's small
Lekki — tied with Marina for the most defaults

findings.claim: Why did head office's read of 'the numbers are fine' miss Ikeja?

options.text: Ikeja issues far fewer loans, so its defaults never looked like a big number next to the bigger branches.
Ikeja's defaults aren't recorded in the system.
They didn't miss it — Marina really is the worst.

successFeedback: Marina and Lekki have more defaulted loans only because they issue far more loans overall. Ikeja is small, but well over half of its loans default — by rate, it's the real problem.
